de.abas.ceks.jedp.query

Interface EDPQueryExecutor

  • All Superinterfaces:
    EDPMessageSourceProvider, EDPProgressMessageSourceProvider

    public interface EDPQueryExecutor
extends EDPMessageSourceProvider, EDPProgressMessageSourceProvider
    Describes query executor, i.e. an instance which executes instances of EDPQueryDescriptor providing instances of EDPQueryResult.
    Author:
    xg

        Executes a message query using a given query descriptor. A message query can retrieve message texts for multiple message numbers or the message number for a particular source message text.

      • execute

        EDPQueryResult execute(TestFieldValueQuery query)
                throws InvalidQueryException
        Executes a field value test for a given list of abas data types and corresponding values. The test result contains information whether a value was valid or not. The test only fails if it was not possible to perform the tests, e.g. because of invalid type strings.
        Parameters:
        query - a TestFieldValueQuery instance
        Returns:
        Result for the query with one row per tested data type/value pair.
        Throws:
        InvalidQueryException - if the tests could not be performed, but not if a test value was invalid
